name: Stream Media
author: Hesper user
description: Netflix-style browsing for movies and TV (top bar, billboard with trailer, wide rows, detail page with cast and episodes), then press Play: the best stream is chosen automatically. On TV a trailer plays when a title is highlighted; on phones you get the description. Uses its own built-in TMDb access, so there is no key to enter (you can still add your own).
